needsAttention.detail: All four girls, Dec 13 to Jan 2. The board gives you until about Oct 15 to book before holiday inventory for six thins out — pick domestic versus refundable-international and commit to one.

needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5 to 18 off-week gap in Maine is the window to drive the Pathfinder Portland to St Pete. It's open now; book the one hotel night once the two dates are set.
